scope: Read-only audit of submitted data/scripts/reports. Original submission unchanged. Added public-database snapshots and this review only to wiki outputs.

overallDecision.genetics: Include a restrained inconclusive/negative exploratory result and quality-control story; do not claim a validated causal effect, protective effect, proven null effect, or formal exclusion of Elafin therapy.
overallDecision.expression: Exclude the submitted GEO forest plot, offline GTEx defaults, cell-type percentages, and triple-hit percentage decomposition. They lack traceable underlying measurements. A newly fetched official GTEx v8 expression snapshot is suitable as tissue context, not an IBD case-control comparison.
overallDecision.sequence: Use current official UniProt P19957 accession, sequence and feature annotations. Exclude the submitted conservation/rate results because the hardcoded human sequence differs from the official sequence actually fetched.

archivedMR.status: archived pipeline output, not validated causal estimate
archivedMR.effectUnits: Pipeline beta is GWAS log-odds divided by a mixed exposure scale: whole-blood Z-derived effects with assumed EAF 0.5 plus lung GTEx normalized-expression slope. Do not label as a validated logOR per SD of colonic PI3, per protein concentration or therapeutic dose.
archivedMR.numericRecalculation: Basic fixed IVW from the four harmonized rows reproduces stored beta, SE and p; this validates arithmetic only.

mrAuditIssues.finding: Three eQTLGen whole-blood signals and one GTEx lung signal are combined as a single exposure; tissue-specific expression is not one interchangeable exposure.
All eQTLGen effects are reconstructed from Z using EAF=0.5. Derived magnitudes and supposed SD units depend on this unverified assumption.
250 kb separation replaces LD-based clumping. The four variants cannot be described as demonstrated independent instruments; no LD reference was provided.

GTEx parser assigns REF as effect allele and comments ref_factor=1 means REF. Official GTEx v8 README says ref_factor=1 means minor allele is ALT. For retained chr20_44403215_G_T_b38 (factor1), G is set as effect allele despite the ALT/minor convention; harmonization must be corrected and verified before causal use.

Retained lung variant nominal p=2.42895e-5 does not meet the stated p<5e-8 rule (conditional rank2, permutation p=.0477952). Independent-eQTL files lack eGene q values in these rows; absence in colon files is not proof that PI3 expression is not genetically regulated in colon.

Custom mr_presso computes a chi-square residual statistic identical to Cochran Q and uses leave-one-out chi-square residuals; it is not the published MR-PRESSO bootstrap procedure. Do not claim MR-PRESSO passed.

Custom directionality averages per-SNP normal-tail probabilities. Stored p=.132 for IBD is not significant, yet report labels direction correct. It is an approximate check, not confirmed directionality.

coloc_abf uses log(n) for H0 and does not subtract the same-variant term from H3. This differs from official coloc combine.abf. Exact PP4 values should not be shown as validated colocalization probabilities.
Exposure region consists of significant eQTLGen rows and GTEx lead variants, not a complete unselected single-tissue regional summary-statistic dataset.
Four signals with one dominant instrument limit sensitivity-test power. Non-significant heterogeneity/pleiotropy tests do not validate MR assumptions.

Report calls results a clean zero effect and formally excludes the original effect; this overstates an exploratory, methodologically unresolved analysis. It also infers expression changes are disease consequences; these results do not establish that.
de Lange UC/CD files are .part incomplete downloads. Available subtype outputs use Pan-UKB, not the de Lange UC/CD cohorts named in the report study-design table.

leadVariantCheck.purpose: Small independent arithmetic and sign check. Not a reanalysis with LD or a validated causal estimate.

outcome.units: log odds of IBD per T allele

waldApproximation.note: First-order ratio SE, reconstructed exposure magnitude. The small p discrepancy versus GWAS comes from rounded beta/SE. No evidence of a protective association from this allele; absence of evidence does not test pharmacological Elafin delivery.

leadVariantCheck.safeDisplay: The strongest blood PI3 cis-eQTL (rs979641) was not associated with IBD in the inspected outcome file (p=0.5011).

exclusions.item: Original claimed MR OR=.68, p=2.4e-5; colocalization PP4=.87; rs6013780 IBD locus
exclusions.reason: Literal hardcoded placeholders, contradicted by later available summary statistics

exclusions.item: GEO meta-analysis log2FC=-2.2800, p=4.27e-60 and forest plots
exclusions.reason: Numerical meta-analysis is computed from a hardcoded list of ten cohort effects/SEs; no supporting GEO matrices, sample metadata, probe-to-gene extraction, contrast or study-level derivations found. Reused controls also need dependence handling.
Archived processed output exactly matches twelve-tissue offline fallback dictionary, not API evidence. Official GTEx v8 query returns materially different values.
Hardcoded illustrative estimates with no traced underlying single-cell or quantitative data.

exclusions.item: Evolutionary Ka, mouse/human identity and residue conservation
exclusions.reason: Script fetches a human record but performs analysis on a different hardcoded human sequence; nonhuman accession and orthology are not validated. Raw position-wise entropy also skips alignment.
Signal/mature-chain/WAP boundaries and all four disulfide pairs disagree with official UniProt P19957; replace with verified source annotations.

uniprot.note: All numbering is the full 117-aa UniProt precursor. This is database annotation, not a new team discovery.

gtex.interpretation: PI3 expression depends strongly on tissue context. Bulk reference tissues do not measure local inflamed mucosal expression or Elafin protein concentrations. This is not an IBD-versus-control contrast.
gtex.displaySuggestion: Log-scale dot/bar chart with exact TPM on hover and selected tissues labeled; identify full54-tissue downloadable source and selection rationale (exposure tissue vs intended delivery site).

suggestedWikiCopy.heading: Evidence sets the boundary.
suggestedWikiCopy.result: Our exploratory genetic analysis did not provide convincing evidence that genetically predicted PI3 expression protects against IBD. The archived IVW run returned p=0.690. A methods audit identified unresolved instrument and harmonization issues, so we do not treat this as a validated causal estimate.
suggestedWikiCopy.decision: We kept genetic support unresolved and focused our design tests on local protein delivery, protease inhibition and controllable persistence.
suggestedWikiCopy.mrFootnote: Archive: four distance-filtered signals from blood and lung; eQTLGen effect sizes reconstructed with assumed allele frequency. Formal LD filtering, allele verification and standard-package validation are required.
suggestedWikiCopy.sequenceBody: The reviewed human PI3 precursor contains 117 amino acids. UniProt annotates mature Elafin at residues61–117 and four disulfide bridges. These boundaries define which molecular entity is being modeled.
suggestedWikiCopy.expressionBody: A verified GTEx v8 snapshot shows that PI3 expression differs across reference tissues. Blood-based genetic instruments cannot stand in for local intestinal delivery.

pathConventions.submission-root: Submitted Elafin-IBD research project root, containing data and 08_clinical_genetics. Paths are relative to this root; local user directories are omitted.
pathConventions.wiki-root: The wiki repository root. Published audit copies preserve source-relative paths; original submitted files remain unchanged.

fba.status: Do not present as EcN flux validation
findings: Actual COBRA optimization calls exist, but iML1515 input MAT/SBML is not included in the submitted project.
The supplied model is K-12 MG1655, not EcN, and examines butyrate rather than Elafin burden.
Exchange and transport reactions reuse EX_but_e; the resulting network needs validation.
Knockout results are not saved with the delivered result tables.
Input is an incorrect 126-residue sequence, rather than the official 117-residue precursor.
The IEDB function returns None; scores are custom heuristics, not verified IEDB, NetMHC or BepiPred results.
ADA risk below 5 percent is unsupported.

evolution.status: Excluded pending sequence and alignment correction
findings: Incorrect input sequences and conservation calculated without a valid multiple sequence alignment prevent interpretation.
